articles.title_cn: 福利分析的稳健性措施
articles.abstract_en: Economists routinely make functional form assumptions on demand curves to derive welfare conclusions. How sensitive are these conclusions to such assumptions? In this paper, we develop robustness measures that quantify the extent to which the true demand curve must deviate from common functional form assumptions in order to overturn a welfare conclusion. We parametrize this variability in terms of the gradient and curvature of the demand curve. By leveraging tools from information design, we show that our measures are easy to compute. Our measures are also flexible and easy to use, as we illustrate through empirical applications.
articles.abstract_cn: 经济学家通常对需求曲线进行函数形式假设，以得出福利结论。这些结论对此类假设有多敏感？在本文中，我们开发了稳健性度量，以量化真实需求曲线必须偏离常见函数形式假设的程度，以便推翻福利结论。我们根据需求曲线的梯度和曲率来参数化这种变化。通过利用信息设计的工具，我们表明我们的措施很容易计算。正如我们通过实证应用所说明的那样，我们的措施也灵活且易于使用。

articles.title_en: Keep Your Enemies Closer: Strategic Platform Adjustments during US and French Elections
articles.title_cn: 拉近你的敌人：美国和法国大选期间的战略平台调整
articles.abstract_en: We study changes in political discourse during campaigns, using a novel dataset of candidate websites for US House elections, 2002–2016, and manifestos for French parliamentary and local elections, 1958–2022. We find that candidates move to the center in ideology and rhetorical complexity between the first round (or primary) and the second round (or general election). This convergence reflects candidates' strategic adjustment to their opponents, as predicted by Downsian competition: Using an RDD we show that candidates converge to the platform of opponents who narrowly qualified for the last round as opposed to those who narrowly failed to qualify.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用美国众议院选举候选人网站 2002-2016 以及法国议会和地方选举宣言 1958-2022 的新颖数据集来研究竞选期间政治话语的变化。我们发现，在 第一 轮（或初选）和 第二 轮（或大选）之间，候选人在意识形态和修辞复杂性方面向中间移动。这种收敛反映了候选人对其对手的战略调整，正如 Downsian 竞争所预测的那样：使用 RDD，我们表明候选人收敛到以微弱优势晋级最后一轮的对手的平台，而不是那些以微弱优势未能晋级的对手的平台。

articles.title_cn: 雇主和失业保险的领取
articles.abstract_en: We quantify the employer's role in unemployment insurance (UI) take-up. Employer effects on claiming and appeals are substantial, and those effects are negatively correlated, consistent with appeals deterring claims. Low-wage workers are less likely to claim and more likely to have their claims appealed than median-wage workers. Employer effects help explain these income gradients, so equalizing employer effects on claiming would increase the progressivity of UI. Finally, the main source of targeting error in UI is that eligible workers do not claim.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们量化了雇主在失业保险 (UI) 领取中的作用。雇主对索赔和上诉的影响很大，并且这些影响呈负相关，这与上诉阻止索赔的情况一致。与中等工资工人相比，低工资工人提出索赔的可能性较小，而且更有可能提出上诉。雇主效应有助于解释这些收入梯度，因此均衡雇主对申领失业救济金的影响将提高失业保险的累进性。最后，UI 中定位错误的主要来源是符合条件的工人没有提出索赔。

articles.title_en: Power Flows: Transmission Lines, Allocative Efficiency, and Corporate Profits
articles.abstract_en: Accelerated investment in electricity transmission could reduce total costs and enhance renewable integration. I document static allocative inefficiencies induced by incomplete market integration in 2 major US markets; these have risen over time and totaled $2 billion in 2022. I also argue that estimating firm-level impacts is important, as incumbents may have the power to block new lines and other reforms. I show that 4 firms would have experienced a collective $1.3 billion drop in net revenues in 2022 had the market been integrated, and there are reports of some of these firms blocking transmission projects.

This paper develops a framework to extend the strategic form analysis of cursed equilibrium (CE) developed by Eyster and Rabin (2005) to multistage games. The approach uses behavioral strategies rather than normal form mixed strategies and imposes sequential rationality. We define and characterize properties of cursed sequential equilibrium (CSE) and apply it to four canonical economic applications: signaling games, reputation building, durable goods monopoly, and the dirty faces game. These applications illustrate various implications of CSE, show how and why it differs from sequential equilibrium and CE, and provide evidence from laboratory experiments that support the empirical relevance of CSE.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文开发了一个框架，将 Eyster 和 Rabin (2005) 开发的诅咒均衡 (CE) 策略形式分析扩展到多阶段博弈。该方法使用行为策略而不是正常形式的混合策略，并强加顺序理性。我们定义并描述了受诅咒的顺序均衡 (CSE) 的属性，并将其应用于 四 规范经济应用：信号游戏、声誉建设、耐用品垄断和脏脸游戏。这些应用说明了 CSE 的各种含义，展示了它与顺序均衡和 CE 的不同之处以及原因，并提供了支持 CSE 经验相关性的实验室实验证据。

articles.title_en: The Negligible Effect of Free Contraception on Fertility: Experimental Evidence from Burkina Faso
articles.title_cn: 免费避孕对生育能力的影响可以忽略不计：来自布基纳法索的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: We conducted a randomized trial among 14,545 households in rural Burkina Faso to test the oft-cited hypothesis that limited access to contraception is an important driver of high fertility rates in West Africa. We do not find support for this hypothesis. Women who were given free access to modern contraception for three years did not have lower birth rates; we can reject even modest effects. We cross-randomized additional interventions to address inefficiencies that might depress demand for free contraception, specifically misperceptions about the child mortality rate and social norms. Free contraception did not significantly influence fertility even in combination with these interventions.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在布基纳法索农村地区的 14,545 家庭中进行了一项随机试验，以检验经常被引用的假设，即避孕手段有限是西非高生育率的重要驱动因素。我们没有找到支持这一假设的证据。在 三 年内免费获得现代避孕措施的妇女的出生率并没有降低；我们甚至可以拒绝轻微的影响。我们交叉随机地采取了额外的干预措施，以解决可能抑制免费避孕需求的低效率问题，特别是对儿童死亡率和社会规范的误解。即使与这些干预措施结合使用，免费避孕也不会显着影响生育能力。

articles.title_en: Monopsony and Employer Misoptimization Explain Why Wages Bunch at Round Numbers
articles.title_cn: 垄断和雇主错误优化解释了为什么工资成整数
articles.abstract_en: We show that administrative hourly wage data exhibit considerable bunching at round numbers. We run two experiments randomizing wages around $0.10 and $1.00 to experimentally measure left-digit bias for identical tasks on Amazon Mechanical Turk; we fail to find any evidence of discontinuity in the labor supply function at round numbers despite estimating a considerable degree of monopsony. We replicate these results in administrative worker-firm hourly wage data from Oregon. We can rule out inattention estimates found in the behavioral product market literature. We provide evidence that firms "misoptimize" wage setting. More monopsony requires less employer misoptimization to explain bunching.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们表明，行政小时工资数据在整数方面表现出相当大的聚集。我们运行 二 实验，将 $0.10 和 $1.00 周围的工资随机化，以实验性地测量 Amazon Mechanical Turk 上相同任务的左位数偏差；尽管估计存在相当程度的垄断，但我们未能找到任何证据表明劳动力供给函数在整数方面存在不连续性。我们将这些结果复制到俄勒冈州行政工人企业的小时工资数据中。我们可以排除行为产品市场文献中发现的注意力不集中估计。我们提供的证据表明企业“错误优化”了工资设定。更多的垄断需要更少的雇主错误优化来解释聚集。

articles.title_en: From Retributive to Restorative: An Alternative Approach to Justice in Schools
articles.abstract_en: School districts historically approached conflict resolution from the perspective that suspending disruptive students was necessary to protect their classmates, even if this caused harm to perceived offenders. Restorative practices (RP)—focusing on reparation, accountability, and shared ownership of disciplinary justice—are designed to address undesirable behavior without harming students. We study Chicago Public Schools' adoption of RP and find that suspensions and arrests decreased, driven by effects for Black students. We find null effects on test score value added, ruling out meaningful average declines. We estimate a 15 percent decrease in out-of-school arrests, consistent with RP substantively changing student behavior.

articles.title_en: Underbidding for Oil and Gas Tracts
articles.title_cn: 石油和天然气领域的投标不足
articles.abstract_en: Common values auction models, where bidder decisions depend on noisy signals of common values, provide predictions about Bayesian Nash equilibrium (BNE) outcomes. In settings where these common values can be estimated, these predictions can be tested. We propose a series of tests, robust to assumptions about the signal structure, to determine whether the observed data could have been generated by a Bayesian Nash equilibrium. In the setting of oil and gas lease auctions in New Mexico, we find evidence that participation decisions are correlated and that participants systematically underbid in light of ex post outcomes.
articles.abstract_cn: 共同价值拍卖模型中，投标人的决策取决于共同价值的噪声信号，提供有关贝叶斯纳什均衡 (BNE) 结果的预测。在可以估计这些共同值的环境中，可以测试这些预测。我们提出了一系列对信号结构假设稳健的测试，以确定观察到的数据是否可以由贝叶斯纳什均衡生成。在新墨西哥州的石油和天然气租赁拍卖中，我们发现有证据表明参与决策是相关的，并且参与者根据事后结果系统性地低估了出价。

articles.title_en: Direct and Indirect Effects of Investment Tax Incentives
articles.title_cn: 投资税收优惠的直接和间接影响
articles.abstract_en: This paper estimates the direct effects and indirect spillover effects of investment tax credits on firms. Exploiting a differential tax credit rate change by firm size in the German manufacturing sector, I find that lowering a firm's investment cost by 7.6 percent increases its capital stock by 17.7 percent and employment by 12.0 percent. Positive local spillovers generate one additional manufacturing job for each directly created job, are strongest between firms in industries connected through input-output linkages, and arise within distances of five kilometers. Firms dependent on local consumer demand also increase employment, while within-industry spillovers generate small negative effects.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文估计了投资税收抵免对企业的直接效应和间接溢出效应。利用德国制造业中企业规模不同的差别税收抵免率变化，我发现将企业的投资成本降低 7.6% 会增加其资本存量 17.7% 和就业人数 12.0%。积极的当地溢出效应为每个直接创造的就业机会带来 一 额外的制造业就业机会，在通过投入产出联系相连的行业中的企业之间最为强大，并且出现在 五 公里的距离内。依赖当地消费者需求的企业也会增加就业，而行业内的溢出效应只会产生较小的负面影响。
